_comment: Class-2 walk-law conformance probes. gt=ruling: expected value is the ZT-verified gate-1 walk law (fused-feedback ruling, binding). gt=oracle: expected value is a PREDICTION from the walk law — must be confirmed against the live oracle (obsidian eval, obsidian-compat@1.12.7 regen) before use as GT; a divergence there is a finding against the PREDICTION, not the app. Fixture vault: fixtures/walkvault/. All refs are raw linktext (wire form, no brackets).

probes.law: anywhere-after — a section-closing heading does NOT stop the walk; crosses closed B, C, and the A boundary
probes.kills: an implementation that scopes the walk to the containment subtree of B

probes.law: generation-skipping — level 1→3 without naming the intermediate X
probes.kills: an implementation requiring parent-child adjacency (level+1 stepping)

probes.law: strictly-deeper-level required — C is level 1, same as B
probes.kills: an implementation matching same-or-deeper; also probes stage-2 error shape (dest present)

probes.law: first-match-wins on duplicates, SILENT on the walk plane (app-exact)
probes.kills: a walk plane that errors ambiguous_ref (that behavior belongs ONLY to the strict plane)
byte-equality leaking from the mint plane into the walk

probes.law: subpath splits on '#' only — 'a/b' is ONE segment naming a literal heading
probes.kills: grammars that treat '/' as a path join (the hpath-join ambiguity, confirmed real)

probes.law: the same characters, one more '#', a DIFFERENT node than WL-6a — the pair must diverge
probes.kills: any canonicalization that makes WL-6a and WL-6b collide

probes.law: case-fold + duplicates composed: fold must not change which duplicate wins
probes.kills: case-normalization reordering duplicate resolution (a UC-R9 cousin on the walk plane)

probes.law: case-insensitivity applies to slash-bearing literal segments too
probes.kills: segment matchers that special-case '/' out of the fold path

expect.note: duplicate basename walk.md exists at root AND sub/ — stage-1 tie-break is a §13.4 pack-pinned unknown; record the oracle's answer, never assume

probes.kills: asserted (rather than pack-pinned) stage-1 tie-break behavior in the contract text

probes.law: stage-1 miss: no dest field; unresolved is first-class
probes.kills: error shapes that cannot distinguish which stage failed (W4 split)

probes.law: duplicate block ids: walk plane follows the app (last wins, silent) — mint-plane counter-probe is MP-2
probes.kills: walk plane borrowing the mint plane's ambiguous_ref refusal (or first-wins)

expect.note: post-decision-011 charset is app-exact [A-Za-z0-9-]+ BOTH planes; '_' makes this id charset-invalid — pin what the app actually does with it

probes.law: decision 011 (charset veto): one charset, both planes; the contract must not resolve what the app will not
probes.kills: the vetoed two-plane superset surviving anywhere reachable (advertise-nothing-resolve-nothing identity, W3)

expect.target: whole file (predicted, via frontmatter alias, case-insensitive)

probes.kills: stage-1 implementations that index basenames only

expect.note: empty subpath after '#' — parseLinktext edge; pin the oracle's answer

probes.law: parse edge — the contract inherits parseLinktext exactly
probes.kills: hand-rolled ref parsers that diverge from parseLinktext on degenerate input
